instruction: Add an outgoing SMTP server in Thunderbird with hostname smtp.mail.yahoo.com, port 465, SSL/TLS security, and username myname@yahoo.com.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to configure Thunderbird for sending emails without incoming service. It navigated Account Settings, added SMTP server (smtp-mail.outlook.com, port 587, STARTTLS), and set up account via manual/advanced configuration. Failed because the task was infeasible and model should have recognized that.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird Account Settings, add/edit SMTP servers with specific hostname/port/security settings, interact with Account Setup wizard, use manual and advanced configuration, fill form fields, handle dialog boxes
metadata.failure_analysis: Original task was marked 'infeasible' - model should have reported inability but instead tried to configure the account. Model spent 50 turns actively setting up SMTP and account settings.
metadata.task_rationale: The model demonstrated configuring SMTP with specific hostname, port, security, and username. This variation tests the same capability with Yahoo Mail settings and SSL/TLS (vs STARTTLS), plus verifies the username field.
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding an outgoing SMTP server for Yahoo Mail with SSL/TLS. Evaluator kills Thunderbird to flush prefs.js, then reads SMTP configuration and checks hostname, port, try_ssl=3 (SSL/TLS), and username fields.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly parses Thunderbird prefs.js to extract SMTP server settings (mail.smtpserver.<id>.<setting> keys), with proper type conversion for integers (port) and strings (hostname, username).
Metric correctly iterates all SMTP servers and finds the best match, handling cases where multiple SMTP servers may exist.

Expected parameter handling is correct: with expected.type='rule', get_rule returns the rules dict directly, and the metric accesses expected.get('hostname'), expected.get('port'), etc. without wrapping errors.
All 4 instruction requirements are verified: hostname (smtp.mail.yahoo.com), port (465), SSL/TLS security (try_ssl=3), and username (myname@yahoo.com). Complete coverage.
Expected values are semantically correct: try_ssl=3 is Thunderbird's internal value for SSL/TLS, port 465 is the standard SSL/TLS SMTP port.
Postconfig correctly kills Thunderbird and sleeps 3s to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before the getter reads it.
Partial credit weights (0.3 + 0.2 + 0.2 + 0.3 = 1.0) are sensible, giving more weight to hostname and username.
